name: Taj Mahal
description: Taj Mahal: The full name is "Taj Mahal". It is one of the most well-known monuments in India. It is a mausoleum built by Shah Jahan, the fifth generation emperor of the Mughal Dynasty, in memory of the late Queen Taj Mahal in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India. It is known as the "perfect building" and the "Pearl of India". The Taj Mahal consists of a palace, a bell tower, a pool, etc., all built with pure white marble and inlaid with glass and agate. It has extremely high artistic value and is one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.
